summary: Backend-only testing for Autoland 07 API. Created pytest suite with 26 tests covering all endpoints listed in review request. 100% pass rate (26/26). Verified: public settings/reviews/inquiry submission with VIN uppercasing, JWT login & /auth/me, admin inquiries list+stats, resolve flow generating review_token, review submission consuming token (409 on second try, also 409 on /reviews/check after submission), public review listing reflects new review, settings PUT (phone update, status toggle to 'break', invalid status 400), DELETE inquiry/review with 404 on repeat, and 401 enforcement on all admin endpoints without token.

minor.issue: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins=['*'] is rejected by browsers; if cookie-based auth is ever needed from web preview, this will break. Bearer-token flow used by current frontend works fine.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on failed logins (auth playbook expects lockout after 5 fails). Not exercised by current frontend but is a known gap.
Returns 409 with 'Recenzia a fost deja trimisă' once review submitted. Behavior is correct, but frontend should distinguish 404 (invalid) vs 409 (already used) for clearer UX.

action_items: Optional: tighten CORS origins (replace '*' with the preview/prod origin) since allow_credentials=True is set.
Optional: add login rate-limit/lockout per auth playbook (5 failed attempts).
Frontend (next iteration): handle 409 from /api/reviews/check/{token} as 'already submitted' state distinct from 404 invalid token.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file (~360 lines) - acceptable for current size; split into routers if it grows >700.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded from all responses (good).
seed_admin correctly idempotent and updates password if changed in env (matches playbook).
bcrypt hashing used (verified hash format $2b$ via successful login round-trip).
seed_data_creation: Tests create one TEST_ inquiry per run, resolve it, submit a review, then DELETE both inquiry and review. Settings phone is mutated to '0729111222' and status briefly toggled to 'break' then restored to 'open'. No persistent test data left except the temporary phone change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_autoland_backend.py for regression. BASE_URL pulled from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with fallback to public preview URL. Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Tests use module-scoped admin_token fixture and pytest namespace attrs (created_inquiry_id, review_token, review_id) to chain steps.
rca_of_issue: No bugs reproduced. All endpoints in scope behave per spec.
